checkSemantics.allowedChecks: Semantic-preservation alternatives. Hierarchy-sufficient implicit expectations include complete tree/null inspection even when a cheaper check is also acceptable. Authority cases retain their exact authored/fixed mode, and visual-only expectations retain visual mode.
checkSemantics.preferredCheapChecks: A separate subset of semantically acceptable checks that is cheaper to run; it does not replace allowedChecks.
checkSemantics.treeOrVisualVerdicts: Tree and visual choices are semantic coverage, but this synthetic corpus assigns no verdict to those modes.
